unknownCapabilities: Whether FX3A firmware revision adds any new PTP3 capabilities not present in original FX3
Exact ND filter availability — FX3 does NOT have built-in ND, confirmed false
notes: FX3 is Sony's compact full-frame cinema camera (E-mount only). No built-in ND filter — ndFilter is false. No T-Number display (no PL mount support). Single CFexpress Type A / SD slot (single dual-format slot counted as slot1 only). Added to PTP3 in v1.3.0 (Jun 2025) as ILME-FX3A (FX3A designation covers both FX3 and FX3 Ver.2). Has shutter angle (0xD00E), gain dB (0xD01E), exposure index (0xD022), BaseLook (0xD03C), timecode. 2 audio channels (3.5mm + XLR via adapter). Color temperature returns enumeration list.
